scope: forecast GHI paired heads FA versus FAC; initialization only
procedure: Construct common A base at seed 42; initialize FA and FAC independently at seed 42; copy the common AGRI encoder/readout weights and zero the auxiliary readout columns; compare parameter hashes and synthetic-input outputs on CPU.
interpretation: The COT arm starts at the same prediction as the no-COT arm; COT can affect predictions only after learning. This verifies initialization fairness, not a trained GHI or forecast-COT result.
